faq.title: Frequently asked questions

items.a: We currently serve Paphos, Limassol and surrounding areas. Send us the property location when booking and we will confirm availability and any travel conditions before the service.

items.q: Do I need to provide cleaning products or equipment?
items.a: Usually we agree this with you in advance. Depending on the service, our team can arrive with the required professional products and equipment. If you prefer specific products to be used in your home or property, tell us when booking.

items.q: How long does a cleaning service take?
items.a: Timing depends on the property size, current condition, number of rooms and the selected service. Deep cleaning, post-renovation cleaning and move-in / move-out work normally require more time than regular maintenance cleaning. We confirm a realistic estimate after reviewing the details.

items.q: Can I book recurring home or office cleaning?
items.a: Yes. Regular home and office cleaning can be arranged weekly, fortnightly or on another agreed schedule, subject to availability. The scope and frequency are tailored to the property and your priorities.

items.q: What is included in Airbnb / vacation rental turnover cleaning?
items.a: Turnover cleaning can include linen and towel change, professional bed making, kitchen and appliance cleaning, bathroom disinfection, dusting, floor cleaning, rubbish removal, high-contact surface disinfection, restocking agreed guest essentials and a final readiness check before the next arrival.

Yes. Post-renovation cleaning starts from €180. It can include construction dust removal, repeated floor and surface washing, removal of paint, sealant, grout, adhesive, mounting foam and protective-film residues where safe to do so. Bulky construction debris is discussed separately.

items.q: Can I book oven or refrigerator cleaning separately?
items.a: Yes. Oven and refrigerator cleaning can be booked separately or together as the Kitchen Essentials Bundle for €30. The bundle combines deep cleaning of both appliances at a lower combined price.

items.q: Do you provide office and commercial cleaning?
items.a: Yes. Office cleaning starts from €45 and can be arranged as a one-off service or on a regular schedule. We tailor the work to the size, usage and condition of the premises, including work areas, kitchens, washrooms, floors and high-contact surfaces.

items.q: How is the final price calculated?
items.a: Displayed prices are starting prices. The final cost depends on the total area, property condition, level of dirt, access, requested extras and the scope of work. We confirm the price with you before the service begins.
Yes. You can contact us directly on WhatsApp for a quick enquiry, or use the booking form to send the property type, location, preferred date and service details in one structured request.

items.q: Do you offer move-in / move-out cleaning?
items.a: Yes. We can prepare a property before moving in or clean it after moving out. The exact scope can include kitchens, bathrooms, wardrobes, accessible interior surfaces, floors, skirting boards and other agreed areas depending on the condition of the property.

items.q: What should I tell you before booking?
items.a: Please share the property type, approximate size, location, preferred date, service required and any priority areas. For deep, post-renovation or move-out cleaning, photos are very helpful for estimating the scope and preparing the correct products and equipment.

privacyText: We collect the information you choose to send through our booking or contact channels so we can respond to your enquiry and arrange services.
We do not sell personal information. Information may be shared only with service providers needed to operate communications or the website, subject to appropriate safeguards.
You may contact us to ask about, correct or request deletion of personal information we hold, subject to applicable obligations.
cookiesText: This website may use essential browser storage to remember language preferences and whether the short opening animation has already been shown.
Essential storage supports basic website functionality. Analytics or marketing cookies should not be added without updating this policy and, where required, requesting consent.
termsText: A booking form submission is a request, not an automatic confirmation. A service is arranged only after Blue Wave Cleaning confirms availability, scope and price.
Guide prices may change according to property size, condition, access and the agreed scope of work. Any material changes should be agreed before service begins.
Specific access, product, cancellation and other change arrangements should be confirmed directly when the booking is accepted.
